notes:
Summary: Enterprise logistics analytics vendor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for inference layer. Primary concern: comprehensive audit stream to their SIEM (Splunk) + KMS key custody. Short decision path if POC proves log fidelity and retention controls.

Key audit logging requirements (from security + infra):
- Full request-level audit stream: every inference request must emit an event with request_id, tenant_id, model, model_version, timestamp, input_token_count, output_token_count, latency_ms, response_status, error_code (if any).
- Access logs: admin console logins, API key usage events, token creation/deletion, and role changes. Must include user_id, auth_method (SAML), IP (CIDR or masked), geo, timestamp.
- Log format/schema: JSON lines (one event per line) with clear top-level fields; sample required. Must support nested 'meta' freeform for debugging but primary fields must be flattened for SIEM parsing.
- SIEM export: push to customer Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC) and optionally to Datadog/Elastic via connectors. Support batching and backpressure; max delivery lag 1 hour. Must provide signed delivery receipts.
- Retention: immutable audit logs 1 year (compliance), operational traces/debug logs 90 days (default), ability to configure shorter/longer per log category. Cold-archive to S3 (region-specific) for up to 7 years with write-once-read-many (WORM) support.
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys (CMK) required for encryption of logged payloads. Support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and bring-your-own-HSM via KMIP. Key rotation policy configurable; log entries must surface the kms_key_id used.
- PII handling/redaction: must flag/redact user-specified fields before export; provide redaction markers in logs (e.g., "pii_redacted": ["email","ssn"]). Allow reversible encryption for tokens under legal process with audit.
- Tamper evidence: append-only logging, sequence numbers, and periodic signed manifests to show integrity (customer asked about cryptographic hashes signed by KMS).
- Sampling/filters: ability to enable full capture for selected tenants (PII-heavy) and sampling for others.

Customer quotes / paraphrase: "We must be able to push the full audit stream into our Splunk within an hour and keep immutable copies for 1 year. If we can get CMK integration + signed manifests we can close."

POC success criteria (security team):
- Demo: Reed (security lead) confirms Splunk HEC ingestion of JSON schema with all required fields.
- Retention: Redwood demonstrates S3 cold-archive with immutability and region 'us-east-1' residency.
- KMS: Customer-managed key (AWS KMS) used for encrypting stored logs & attestable key id in each event.
- Integrity: Signed manifest produced daily covering all logs; verification script provided.

Integration notes/requests to product:
- Provide recommended log schema (v1) with exact field names and required/optional flags.
- Support HEC authentication (token), retries, backoff params, and monitoring hooks.
- Expose toggle for 'full' vs 'sampled' audit stream per-tenant.
- Provide retention policy UI + terraform module for S3 lifecycle/WORM settings.
- Example Splunk ingestion dashboard & saved searches (prebuilt queries).

Other friction:
- Legal wants a completed security questionnaire (sent 2026-02-12).
- Procurement asks for pricing for KMS/HSM seats and expected egress for SIEM export.

Quote from infra: "If logs contain raw customer inputs we need explicit redaction/encryption flags — ops cannot accept free-text payloads in splunk without masking."
